name: TC-1984: unsubscribe on the public page skips the next product update (OPTED_OUT) but not a service notice; Resubscribe turns it back on
description: The team member opens the unsubscribe link from TC-1982 and presses Unsubscribe. The next PRODUCT_UPDATE reaches the owner and skips the team member (report: SKIPPED OPTED_OUT, no email in the inbox). A SERVICE notice still reaches them. Resubscribe (same page, same token) clears it: the next PRODUCT_UPDATE reaches them again.
